outcome.technical: plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_floor_guard.py: the line accounting is gone - _HOOK, _signature, _own_lines, _changed, _mentioned, _bound_names, _inert, _unaccounted and the list of inert additions are deleted; nothing of them stays. In their place S and U, both over syntax trees. _statements now records for each statement its parent record, the part of the parent holding it, and `place` = the chain (enclosing heads + part + every pytestmark) closed by the count of non-unit statements before it in its own part (a leading docstring is no statement, as before). U: _test_units/_compare_definitions and _checks/_compare_checks compare units by own syntax and place, a check's signature now starts with its callee dump; a unit with the same text and another place is a finding saying it moved, from base line and place to tree line and place (_moved_what/_place_text). A gone/fresh unit's cross-file move signature carries its place, checks included, so a check moved to another file is the same unit only at the same position there. S: _rest builds each copy's non-unit statements as a tree (reading = _head for a compound statement, ast.dump otherwise; a part holding only units is no part); _same_rest compares them; when they differ _fit fits the base rest into the tree rest in order and in place (earliest pairing) and _rest_reason writes the not-compared reason: 'only added' naming the first added statement at its tree line, else 'changed or removed' naming the first base statement with no place (descending into a same-head statement) at its base line. A file new to the diff is read against an empty base. The clean/partly-read basis gains 'N existing unit(s) compared, M new unit(s) counted and not judged: <names>' (_units_text; a unit moved in from another file is not new). Block shape and keys unchanged. Docstring, PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE section, README floorGuard.mode row, CHANGELOG entry and the execute-task.md kind sentence state the rule and what the reading does not claim (structure only, never evaluates code; new = not judged; code outside the diff's test files read by other rules or not at all; the identical-head sibling blind spot, probed: a check moved between two `if True:` blocks across FAILED.clear() reads clean). tests/test__floor_guard.py: new fm64-fm71, fx5, fa41-fa45, fx4 rewritten; the suite prints 134/134. CASES CHANGED ON PURPOSE (each pinned the replaced rule): fa25 asserted the grown file (import+helper+test) clean, now not clean with 'only added' at tree line 1 (`import json`), the reworded half still clean; fa26 asserted a check plus its set-up line clean, now partly-read 'only added' at tree line 14; fa32 moved a labelled check into a NEW function `_more` of the other file and asserted no finding (that is input (f)), now moves it to the same position in the other file's `_cases`; fm52 asserted [0,1,0] findings for r1..r3, now [0,1,1] (r3 has the new for/try before it); fm55 asserted PARTLY_READ, now FINDINGS with r1..r3 moved and still names line 12; fa33 asserted clean, now partly-read 'only added' at the first set-up line (14 / 15); fa34 asserted a new helper inert and clean, now partly-read 'only added' at `def triple(n):`; fa40 asserted a new file with module code and a new group of checks clean, now both partly-read 'only added' (tree line 1 `import sys`, tree line 9 `def more(check):`), the SkipTest-catching test still clean; fm63 asserted exactly one r2 finding in both copies, now that the r2 finding says 'differs' in both and the both-copies run has one finding (the grown run also reports r1/r3 moved, the helper standing before them); fx4 replaced. INVARIANT ROUTE (fx4): units found by the case's own walk, their line spans overwritten in the source text by a placeholder name, the two texts' ast.dump compared with placeholders deleted; the kind by deleting the tree statements whose every line difflib calls inserted and comparing again; a unit's position by the dump with only that unit marked - no helper shared with the guard. Over 326 generated edits (operators: inserted call, inserted assignment of a call, new def with a call default, new unit after each statement, wrap under a new condition, move above the previous statement, move between the parts of an if and of a try, pure reformat) the guard agrees on every one (153 only added, 67 changed or removed, 7 unit lost or moved, 99 clean). Measured on HEAD's guard in a scratch copy, the new test file prints SELFTEST FAILED: 116/134 with assertion failures only. Mutation probe (15 rows, one per half and per allow twin, copy-only, anchors asserted once, pycache purged): every row caught, exit 0. Reviewer probes against this tree: p1_deny X1-X10 all not clean (X8 findings + not compared, the rest partly-read with the statement named, X9/X10 'changed or removed' at base line 7); p4_crossfile C1, C2, C3 all findings. p3_allow: A2, A4, A5, A6, U1 clean; A1 on test__fmt and test__id_shape partly-read, A3, A7, U2, U3, U4 partly-read (clean before: the stated cost); A1 on test__excerpt.py is FINDINGS (ex8, ex9 moved) - p3's own check detector sees only plain-string labels, so its set-up line lands between ex7 and ex8, and under the stated position rule those two now have one more non-unit before them. MEASUREMENT over this repository's 1031 task commits (sg1.19 measure.py, HEAD's guard vs this tree): before clean 293, declared 1, findings 303, partly-read 434; after clean 236, declared 1, findings 577, partly-read 217. Transitions: findings->findings 303, partly-read->findings 271, clean->clean 236, partly-read->partly-read 163, clean->partly-read 54, clean->findings 3. Could-hold files not compared after: 853 only added, 751 changed or removed. No commit lost a finding (0 by move+path+line). Of the 274 commits newly reading findings, 256 hold only 'moved' findings (10108 moved findings in all): the count part of the position rule makes every check after an inserted set-up line a finding. Dependant suites: test_drive_phase stages flr-block, flr10-block, wf-block 22/22; test__filed_returns 146/146; test_audit_lookup 207/207; test__status_facts 199/199; sweep --jobs 4 over test__deps, test__output_lints, test__refs, test__floor_guard: 4/4 files ok, 926 cases; prove-gates --list exit 0; measure-context --gate GATE OK; ruff and vermin 3.8 clean; the phase gate run without --record: GATE GREEN. Dependants: drive-phase.py still correct (calls find_moves, files the same block shape; reason and basis text changed only); audit-lookup.py and _filed_returns.py still correct (read the same keys; their suites pass); tests/test__filed_returns.py and tests/test__status_facts.py still correct (constants unchanged); PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md changed (the section rewritten; the eslint-disable sentence untouched); CHANGELOG.md, README.md, execute-task.md changed as above. Grep for the removed phrases (inert addition, every inert, _HOOK, harmless) over tests/ and tools/: no other suite or tool quotes the guard's wording; remaining 'inert' hits are other subjects (ADO INERT, INERT_EXTENSIONS) and fm62's unchanged label.
outcome.descriptive: The floor guard compares a Python test file only when its code outside the tests is identical and every existing test or check keeps its syntax, position and callee; there is no list of harmless additions any more, and a file not compared says whether that code was only added or was changed, naming the statement.
